goal: Make isolated Workflow nodes establish the exact campaign base before judging it
asset: Compiled graph base checks, result provenance and native isolation controls
scope: Clean linked worktree fast-forward and exact-base equality
Required launch root and schema-bound baseSeen
Wrong-base result refusal across live and replay paths
Portable actual CLI localhost runtime controls
Generated Workflow source starts with public pure-literal metadata
outOfScope: Resetting, detaching or moving the shared checkout

record.question: How can an isolated worker reach and prove the campaign base without moving unrelated commits or the shared checkout?

options.strongest_objection: Requires a real-runtime isolation acceptance probe and schema migration
Refuses safe behind worktrees and accepts ahead worktrees the campaign never judged

record.rationale: Only a clean worker-owned tree may fast-forward; equality and a required typed observation bind every accepted result to the campaign base. Runtime settings are advisory because overrides exist.
evidence: Issue #188 measured the behind/ahead ancestry asymmetry
CLI2.1.312 native Workflow wf_caab2783-42b refused an outside shared-ref write and allowed own-worktree ff-only to exact base with unchanged branch
Independent raw native journal/meta/API capture review passed on Linux
Actual CLI refused generated source because const PLUGIN preceded the required first-statement metadata export

costs.cost: Explicit base observation schemas, a small setting preflight and native fixture
evidence: Compiler already wraps node schemas and all spawns centrally

costs.cost: Wasted workers behind the base and unjudged ahead commits
evidence: Issue #188 and actual fresh worktree native probe

requirements.statement: Extract and run emitted plain-command preamble controls: clean behind linked worktrees reach the exact base on their own branch; shared, dirty, ahead, divergent and missing-object trees stop without moving HEAD
requirements.counterexample: An ancestry-only check accepts ahead or stops a safe behind worker, or moves the shared checkout

requirements.statement: Require launch root for worktree nodes and full-hex baseSeen on every schema carrying the base preamble; missing, malformed and mismatched observations file WRONG-BASE and contribute no findings across node forms and replay
requirements.counterexample: A fan-out, repair checker or restored result contributes findings from a different commit

requirements.statement: Report head, fresh/absent or unknown worktree base settings with scope and override caveats, without passing or refusing launches from that reading
requirements.counterexample: A local setting is represented as effective managed runtime policy

requirements.statement: A separately invoked portable localhost-only actual CLI fixture requires real Workflow worktree metadata, an outside-write isolation refusal and own-branch exact-base fast-forward under normal permissions; no model-quality or provider-cost claim
requirements.counterexample: A simulated executor, generic permission denial or bypass mode is presented as native isolation acceptance

checks.scope: Executed compiler, Git state, result and advisory preflight regressions; actual CLI native acceptance runs separately on installed runtimes
assumptions: Native runtime controls use scripted local model replies and prove permission/isolation behavior, not model quality

checks.scope: Closed baseSeen extension and actual compiled Node-to-recorder roundtrip against native capture fixtures
assumptions: Fixture captures exercise binding enforcement; the separate actual CLI control establishes live runtime behavior

challenges.claim: Does a successful simulated Git command establish the runtime isolation guard permits it?
challenges.resolution: No. Actual installed CLI Workflow worker captures must show both an outside-write guard refusal and the own-directory fast-forward; Windows requires the same native fixture before closure.
